basics.name: Sandy (Alexandra) Tayts
basics.label: UX Designer | Service Design, Product Ownership (PMP) and AI
basics.summary: UX and service designer with over ten years of experience serving both global enterprises and small businesses. Redesigned complex workflows for BP and EY. Designed and built the online store for Rancourt & Co., a heritage footwear maker. Now designs and builds AI products, including LAZY, a website service for vacation-rental hosts.

work.name: InkPromptu
highlights: LAZY (founder, design and build, 2026): launched a done-for-you website service for vacation-rental hosts in October 2026. Ten hosts live in five weeks.
LAZY: researched 15 Facebook host groups (60 posts, 200+ answers) and built the offer around their top fear: guest trust.
LAZY: designed a live-preview editor and a static guest site. Design tokens drive palette, shape and type.
LAZY: designed a guest-facing AI assistant that answers questions about each property. Built with Claude Code and Codex.

Rancourt & Co. (Shopify consultant and service designer, 2026): rebuilt the Shopify store for a heritage Maine shoemaker that made Team USA's Olympic ceremony shoes and makes shoes for Saint Laurent, Ralph Lauren, Brooks Brothers, Cole Haan and Sperry.
Rancourt: built the store with Claude Code. The brand's team now runs it alone.
Rancourt: modeled products in Shopify metaobjects. Cut 14,000+ product patterns to 150 with a shared parts library.
Rancourt: ran discovery workshops and six moderated user tests. Reduced the main menu from nine items to five.
Rancourt: fixed 11,525 broken URLs and 3,940 server errors. Cut third-party apps from 24 to 2.
Rancourt: raised mobile Lighthouse performance from 37 to 100 and accessibility from 85 to 100. Kept search rankings.
Pleasant Street (founder, design and build, 2026): building a directory of independent vacation homes booked direct, with map search and AI-readable pages.
Loomik (UX and UI design): designed UX and UI for an AI sales platform. It surfaces client needs and coaches managers in real time.

work.name: Wipro Digital
work.position: Managing Consultant, Product Owner and Designer
highlights: BP sales modernization (UX and service designer, DocuSign delivery head, 2021–2023): redesigned sales processes in four markets with $2.1B in annual sales.
BP: delivered the largest US DocuSign CLM implementation as of 2023.
BP: as Product Owner and Scrum Master, aligned 50+ people across three teams and nine time zones.
BP: consolidated four processes into one, with 25% fewer steps and 70% less manual effort.
BP: cut end-to-end process time from 15.5 to 8 days and user time per process by 63%.
BP: reduced manual processes from 35 to 8. Raised agreements stored online from 30% to 98%.
BP: designed all DocuSign CLM and e-signature templates.
BP: integrated Salesforce and DocuSign via OAuth 2 APIs. Removed up to 95% of repeated data entry.
BP: built a Center of Excellence with in-app and video guides. Positive experience rose from 55% to 83%.

EY Digital Hub (service and integration design, 2019–2020): led the Digital Hub team, one of five teams on EY's IT-support bid, covering service and UX design, business analysis and technical architecture.
EY: analyzed 30+ surveys, interviews and past incidents. Designed AI self-help, self-service and proactive support journeys.
EY: delivered MVP journeys, an interactive prototype, a wireflow explorer and a five-year implementation plan.
Connected Employee and IT Automation (AI-assisted B2B SaaS): owned personalization for Connected Employee, tailoring content to each user's role and live device data.
Won the GCG Team Award for Best Consulting Asset Solution as Lead Designer.
Led roadmap and delivery of AI-assisted B2B SaaS. Set KPIs that achieved 30% ticket deflection for IT Automation.
Clients: BP, Humana, EY, Warner Bros., Estée Lauder.

work.name: CAFEX
highlights: Defined customer journeys, process flows and specifications for an omnichannel Microsoft Dynamics CRM app.
Won Microsoft approval on first handoff. Earned preferred-product status within four months of release.
Owned the roadmap. Designed the Angular front end and a design system for desktop CRM platforms.

work.name: Various Clients
highlights: Looped In (UX and UI designer and design manager, 2015): designed and built 150 screens for a college incentives app in one month.
Looped In: onboarded four universities, each with its own skin. First app of its kind on the market.
Looped In: built an interactive prototype that won proposals across 15 clients.
Endurance International Group (web hosting): designed client dashboards for hosting customers.
Vecna (workforce-management software): led user research, roadmap, delivery planning and prototyping.
Careport (medical web app): designed and built the front end of an ADA-compliant medical web app used across Massachusetts hospitals.

work.name: Adobe
highlights: Led an 18-person vendor team for localized Flash (Animate). Proposed and shipped 20+ features.
Set localization and terminology standards adopted across the Adobe suite.
